ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio with approximately 40% high-intensity white pixels localized on lateral lobes against 60% low-intensity black pixels across the central and border regions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Two primary high-intensity white contiguous blobs on the lateral lobes. Left lobe contains a large white region with three distinct vertical black linear intrusions. Right lobe contains a large white region with high-density, fine-grained black mottling. The central fluke area is a solid, low-intensity black vertical band.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 85 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration pattern along the entire continuous boundary; prominent jagged peaks (amplitude 5-10 pixels) located at the distal lobe tips, transitioning to smaller, more regular serrations toward the notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve along the medial trailing edge, transitioning to a sharp outward/upward sweep at the lateral extremities.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Highly localized clusters of high-intensity white circular pixels located on the extreme distal tips of both the left and right lobes, consistent with barnacle colonization sites.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Five distinct, near-parallel vertical black linear disruptions on the left white lobe; scattered low-contrast horizontal scratches on the right white lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent barnacle colonies on both fluke tips; vertical rake mark scars on the left lobe pigmentation.
other_distinctive_markers: Trailing organic or synthetic filamentous debris visible extending from the far-right tip of the fluke.
